component.name: rx
component.summary: Update the NixOS system in one deliberate run

description.p: rx runs the whole NixOS update cycle: pull the dotfiles repository, optionally update the flake inputs, stage the changes, rebuild and switch the system, prune old generations and show the closure diff.

The desktop app supervises the rx command line tool one step at a time, so the workflow, its validation and its argv stay in a single place. It shows the pipeline, the live output of every step and asks once before anything touches the running system.
